newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FRENCH DEFENDER BLONDEAU JOINS SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH DEFENDER BLONDEAU JOINS SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY.

text.p: French international defender Patrick Blondeau, a key figure in Monaco's French championship-winning team this season, joined English premier league Sheffield Wednesday for 1.8 million pounds ($3 million) on Tuesday.
Blondeau, who has made two appearances for France as a substitute, said he was relishing the chance of playing in England.
"I think the English game will suit me, I have watched English football on TV at home and I really can't forsee too many problems," he said.
"English football is fast and aggressive but I think I can be seen to be a good defender in England.

"I had my best season for Monaco last year when I broke into the national team and was voted the best defender in France. But I was at Monaco for eight years, I'm 29 and feel ready to learn about another country now."
England coach Glenn Hoddle, who had a spell with Monaco in the 1980s, recommended the player to the club.
